text: I was recommended this clinic in Phuket by a friend and decided to book a full-body hair removal session. Literally from neck to toe :)) The staff impressed me with their professionalism, and they efficiently completed the treatment within an hour. The results were fantastic! Although a few areas will require follow-up sessions, I am confident that a few more treatments will be sufficient given the nature of my hair. Overall, I had a great experience with the clinic’s excellent services and friendly staff. Thank you!

Today I had laser hair removal on my bikini area. It normally costs 1690 baht, but during the procedure I also requested laser hair removal on my anal area, and they asked for an extra 1300 baht, which I refused. This was my second visit; they didn't charge this much on my first visit. When I left, they said they would make it up to me on my next visit. I will never consider coming back here again.

I went to getting hair removal services, got warm welcome from staffs there. The treatments went well with Khun BB  ( therapist) ,she did very good work . So my overall experience with Diora clinic was great . I would Recommended .

“I had lip fillers done at Diora and I’m really happy with the result. It looks so natural and suits my face perfectly. I also feel safe because all the products they use are approved by the Thai FDA and legally certified. The clinic is very clean and the staff takes great care of me .I also got Sculptra, and I can already feel my skin getting firmer and healthier. Plus, I did a vitamin drip too—didn’t hurt at all! The nurse was so gentle.”

Update 15.04.25

Pictures 1 week after resolving the misplaced fillers in a different branch in Patong. the bump next to the lips are not gone but it is way better than before - see picture. The Botox between eyebrows and forehead I got instead in Patong was good. One eyebrow I can move and the other one not at all. But it might change. The lifting effect of the eye brows I don't see much but they told me honestly from the beginning so it's completely fine. I wanted to try it once. Very cute staff, not pushy or in a rush, very caring, got nice skin treatment, explained everything and listened to what you really want and they were the only ones recognizing that the previous fillers look very odd and wrong. I appreciated that a lot! Downside from this experience is that I lost quite some money, time and nerves as my treatment is not equal to what I paid as explained below. Mistakes can happen, that's okay. It could have been very easy and quick for the management and first doctor to recognize, acknowledge, change and fix the situation immediately but it became difficult and long with unnecessary comments.

Update 07.04.25:
After some back and forth I had to drive to Patong branch to resolve a previously misplaced filler, as I preferred a different doctor. But the management made clear that I will not get a treatment worth 100% what I paid ( 17.000 thb) but Botox worth less than that (lower would be 11k/10k). according to them they deduct my money because a customer saw my experience and canceled their appointment because of me. Not sure what to say to this.

Original post:
Most horrible result. I went to this beauty studio and asked specifically for thread lift and maybe fillers under the eyes or Botox so that my face will look more slim, fresh and uplifted. Later at my appointment the doctor said he won't do thread lifting and recommended like the deep wrinkles on the cheek, the smile lines. I was very hesitant because I really don't like this style of fillers where the face looks big round or fat at the cheeks and communicated it. He assured it won't be like that because of his technique. I paid 17.000 thb (450eur). Now I look like a fat sad hamster like already predicted. The face is more saggy downwards now,  very bumpy, second wrinkle appeared, worse than before. Also the front desk staff can be a bit pushy sales wise. I got a call out of the blue on the weekend to make an appointment. In the clinic they made offer after offer until I had to ask them to stop suggesting more treatments. I went there twice after the treatment because I saw directly this will go in the wrong direction. The doctor said I need to wait over a month because it is only swollen and maybe he would need to put more filler there. I did not believe it because it was visible and putting more would look horribly bad and at the wrong place, so I felt unsafe to go back. Maybe they are good with skin that is full of fillers already or tight like a 20 year old. I prefer my old wrinkles back. Obvious that I had a bad treatment but the doctor can't see it. Embarrassing.
